about: SCION 40 · Physical Tabletop Capture: every asset in film.mp4. Nothing from the web; no generated images from models; no faces.

assets.what: the performers' hands in the capture plate (inset and title card only; never in the replayed scene)
assets.operation: SAM 2.1 hand mask per frame; forearm traced column by column as the bright run continuous with the wrist; arm extended beyond the frame edge by repeating its last columns along its slope; tinted warm; scaled 1.5x, rotated and placed with fingertips on each puppet tab (build/hands.py, build/plate.py); mirrored for the two left hands

assets.what: 37 paper body cards of the dog (stand, 8 walk-low, 8 back-away crouched, 8 upright steps, 3+3 turn views, settle and lie, facing both ways)
assets.rights: made for this film (SCION 40); no source material
assets.operation: silhouettes drawn from a small geometric guide (ellipsoids and limbs posed per card, orthographic view at a fixed yaw) only to keep the views consistent; each card cut once as flat paper (scissor-wobble edge, grain, marker line); cut twice: plate style (white card + fiducial tab) and skin style (ochre paper, dark saddle)

assets.what: 11 paper head cards (profile both ways, ears up/back/flat, rear and front views, the back-of-head look-in card)
assets.operation: as the body cards; pinned at the neck by the contact constraint in the replay

assets.what: 7 paper cards of the person (stand, call, reach, step, going down, sit, sit with a low hand)
assets.operation: capsule shapes cut as paper; drawn face, not a real person

assets.what: 3 door-leaf cards (ajar, mid, open) and a yellow tissue light piece
assets.operation: cut paper; the light is slid out through the doorway by a hand; the room's lit/dark mix follows that recovered slide

assets.what: the layout sheet on the table: pencil floor line, wall, doorway, metre ruler, 4 corner fiducials
assets.operation: drawn; synthesized onto a procedural wood table under a synthesized overhead camera (homography, lamp falloff, blur, noise, JPEG)

assets.what: torn-paper dusk sky, moon, hills, fence, porch boards and steps, cut-away house and room (lamp, table, picture), dark and lit versions
assets.operation: procedural torn and cut paper with grain and lifted shadows

assets.what: 8-bit-id square markers (7 id bits, complement, parity, orientation cells)
assets.operation: printed on each plate card tab and the sheet corners; decoded by build/track.py

assets.what: voice (Come here x2, It's all right x2, Come in), paper foley driven by the recovered event stream, room tone, crickets
Big Shoulders Display, JetBrains Mono, Literata
assets.operation: title and end cards, inset caption
read to write the performers' sheet (perform.py) and to check the invariants
